targets.title: Working memory flips the direction of serial bias through memory-based decision
targets.evidence_quote:
Here, we report a direct replication of Experiments 1A/1B by
Chen and Bae (2024a)
with a minor difference: We used a within-subject design instead of a between-subject design.
targets.outcome_quote: To preview our findings, we successfully replicated the original study, demonstrating repulsive response trajectories that ended with an attractive bias when an extra Stroop task was introduced but remained repulsive without it.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall successful replication verdict, reiterated in the conclusion. The initial-trajectory difference is discussed separately.

reasoning: New participants retest Chen and Bae 2024a Experiments 1A/1B; the other Chen and Bae preprint is contextual discussion.
